messages.subject: Minor issue with 'make stan-update'?
parts:
I noticed below warning messages. The file is clearly available, but 1 level deeper ( .../cmdstan/stan/src/stan/version.hpp).

Might just be temporarily, while the separation of stan and cmdstan is in progress.

Rob J. Goedman
goe...@icloud.com


From https://github.com/stan-dev/cmdstan
 * branch            develop    -> FETCH_HEAD
Already up-to-date.

grep: /Users/rob/Projects/Stan/cmdstan/src/stan/version.hpp: No such file or directory
grep: /Users/rob/Projects/Stan/cmdstan/src/stan/version.hpp: No such file or directory
git submodule init
git submodule update
Robs-15inch-2:cmdstan rob$

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Minor issue with 'make stan-update'?
parts:
Hi Rob,

Sorry about the delay in getting back to you. This only happens when the Stan submodule (within cmdstan, the folder stan) isn't updated. Hopefully after the call to "make stan-update" it stopped reporting that message.

I'm not sure how to squash that message, but since it only happens when the Stan submodule is empty and doesn't happen afterwards, I'm not too worried about trying to find out how to stop the message. Let me know if it's still popping up and I'll try to figure out a way to prevent the message from popping up.


Daniel
